trait.name: Planar Footing
entries: The magister has advantage on saving throws against being pushed, pulled, knocked prone, or teleported against its will.

spellcasting.name: Conclave Spellcasting
headerEntries: The magister casts one of the following spells, using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 17}, {@hit 9} to hit with spell attacks):

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The magister makes two Rift Lance attacks.

action.name: Rift Lance
entries: {@atk rs} {@hit 9} to hit, range 120 ft., one target. {@h}18 ({@damage 3d8 + 5}) force damage. The magister can move the target 10 feet horizontally if it is Large or smaller.

action.name: Gravitic Fold (Recharge 5-6)
entries: Each enemy in a 20-foot-radius sphere centered on a point the magister can see within 90 feet must make a DC 17 Strength saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 31 ({@damage 7d8}) force damage, is pulled up to 20 feet toward the center, and is knocked prone. On a successful save, it takes half as much damage and isn't moved or knocked prone.

bonus.name: Vector Step
entries: The magister teleports itself or one willing allied creature it can see within 30 feet up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space the magister can see.

reaction.name: Deflect Trajectory
entries: When the magister or a creature within 10 feet of it is hit by a ranged attack, the magister adds 4 to the target's AC against that attack, potentially causing it to miss.
